arxiv-2012-07456.description: Abstract Context. On 2020 April 19 a coronal mass ejection (CME) was detected in situ by Solar Orbiter at a heliocentric distance of about 0.8 AU. The CME was later observed in situ on April 20 by the Wind and BepiColombo spacecraft whilst BepiColombo was located very close to Earth.

arxiv-2101-00258.title: Superparamagnetic dynamics and blocking transition in Fe 3 O 4 nanoparticles probed by vibrating sample magnetometry and muon spin relaxation
arxiv-2101-00258.creator: Benjamin A. Frandsen, Charlotte Read, Jade Stevens, Colby Walker, Mason Christiansen, Roger G. Harrison, Karine Chesnel
arxiv-2101-00258.description: Abstract The magnetic properties of Fe 3 O 4 nanoparticle assemblies have been investigated in detail through a combination of vibrating sample magnetometry and muon spin relaxation ( μ \mu SR) techniques. Two samples with average particle sizes of 5 nm and 20 nm, respectively, were studied.

arxiv-2207-08358.title: Rigorous Justification of Wave Kinetic Theory
arxiv-2207-08358.creator: Yu Deng, Zaher Hani
arxiv-2207-08358.description: Abstract . The main purpose of this expository note is to give a short account of the recent developments in mathematical wave kinetic theory. After reviewing the physical theory, we explain the importance of the notion of a “scaling law”, which dictates the relation between the asymptotic parameters as the kinetic limit is taken.

arxiv-2212-13420.title: Self Meta Pseudo Labels: Meta Pseudo Labels Without The Teacher
arxiv-2212-13420.creator: 1 st Kei-Sing Ng, 2 nd Qingchen Wang
arxiv-2212-13420.description: Abstract We present Self Meta Pseudo Labels, a novel semi-supervised learning method similar to Meta Pseudo Labels [ 1 ] but without the teacher model. We introduce a novel way to use a single model for both generating pseudo labels and classification, allowing us to store only one model in memory instead of two.

arxiv-2308-10942.creator: Xiao Lin Li, Xiaohui Liu, Feng Yuan, Hua Xing Zhu
arxiv-2308-10942.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xiao Lin Li, Xiaohui Liu, Feng Yuan, Hua Xing Zhu. We present an innovative approach to the linearly polarized gluons confined inside the unpolarized nucleon in lepton-nucleon scattering. Our method analyzes the correlation of energy flows at azimuthal separations ϕ \phi . The interference of the spinning gluon with both positive and negative helicities translates into a cos ⁡ ( 2 ​ ϕ ) \cos(2\phi) asymmetry imprinted on the detector.

pmc-10674615.title: Pseudovirus Nanoparticles Displaying Plasmodium Circumsporozoite Proteins Elicited High Titers of Sporozoite-Binding Antibody
pmc-10674615.creator: Ming Xia, Pengwei Huang, Frank Vago, Wen Jiang, Ming Tan
pmc-10674615.description: Background: malaria caused by Plasmodium parasites remains a public health threat. The circumsporozoite proteins (CSPs) of Plasmodium sporozoite play a key role in Plasmodium infection, serving as an excellent vaccine target. Methods: using a self-assembled S60 nanoparticle platform, we generated pseudovirus nanoparticles (PVNPs) displaying CSPs, named S-CSPs, for enhanced immunogenicity.

pmc-11322272.title: Integrative single-cell and bulk transcriptome analyses identify a distinct pro-tumor macrophage signature that has a major prognostic impact on glioblastomas
pmc-11322272.creator: Peilin Li, Guolei Su, Yinglin Cui
pmc-11322272.description: Glioblastoma (GBM) is a highly heterogeneous disease with poor clinical outcomes. To comprehensively dissect the molecular landscape of GBM and heterogeneous macrophage clusters in the progression of GBM, this study integrates single-cell and bulk transcriptome data to recognize a distinct pro-tumor macrophage cluster significantly associated with the prognosis of GBM and develop a GBM prognostic signature to facilitate prior subtypes.

pmc-11325646.title: Quantification of Polyphosphate in Environmental Planktonic Samples Using a Novel Fluorescence Dye JC-D7
pmc-11325646.creator: Xingyu Yang, Rixuan Gao, Qiong Zhang, Charmaine C M Yung, Hongbin Yin, Jiying Li
pmc-11325646.description: Polyphosphate (polyP) is found in plankton of diverse aquatic ecosystems and is important for plankton ecology and biogeochemical cycling. However, our knowledge of polyP in aquatic environments is hindered by a lack of data due to the limitations of quantification methods.

pmc-11331207.title: Diagnosis and treatment of solid pseudopapillary tumor of the pancreas: A single center’s experience
pmc-11331207.creator: Ahmet Gokhan Saritas, Mehmet Onur Gul, Abdullah Ulku, Serdar Gumus, Ishak Aydin, Atilgan Tolga Akcam
pmc-11331207.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). OBJECTIVEThe present study reviews the records of patients with solid pseudopapillary pancreas neoplasm (SPT).METHODSA total of 13 patients diagnosed with SPT were included in the study. The criteria for SPT in the pathology specimens were the presence of cells with an oval round orthochromatic nucleus, with a thin chromatin structure and no nucleolus distinction, lined around a fibrovascular papilla in cystic areas.RESULTSThe study included 11 female and two male patients, with a mean age of 33.07 (range: 16–73) years.

pmc-11506492.title: Clogged Arteries, Safety Net Holes: Treating an Underinsured Patient for Homozygous Familial Hypercholesterolemia With Plasmapheresis
pmc-11506492.creator: Parth Patel, Iheoma Alinnor, Mary Ann Kirkconnell Hall, Lance T Hall, Stacey Watkins
pmc-11506492.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This case report explores the difficulties with rapid lipid-lowering therapies in a resource-limited setting. We present a case of an individual with previously diagnosed homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia presenting with anginal chest pain concerning for non-ST elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI), with a low-density lipoprotein (LDL) of 984 mg/dL (reference range: 100-129 mg/dL) and a reversible perfusion defect on his nuclear medicine stress test.

pmc-11604011.title: Ergothioneine ameliorates metabolic dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD) by enhancing autophagy, inhibiting oxidative damage and inflammation
pmc-11604011.creator: Xiaoyu Lv, Chenyu Nie, Yihan Shi, Qincheng Qiao, Jing Gao, Ying Zou, Jingwen Yang, Li Chen, Xinguo Hou
pmc-11604011.description: BackgroundMetabolic dysfunction-associated steatosis liver disease (MASLD) is one of the most common metabolic liver diseases around the world, whose prevalence continues to increase. Currently, there are few medications to treat MASLD. Ergothioneine is a natural compound derived from mushrooms whose sulfhydryl groups confer unique antioxidant, anti-inflammatory and detoxifying effects.

pmc-12645059.title: Quinoa Improves Non‐Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease by Regulating the Ras‐PLD Pathway to Activate Autophagy
pmc-12645059.creator: Yuelin Zhang, Zhengting Liang, Jiaxian Liu, Xianjie Zhen, Ruijie Liu, Xiaohong Luo, Guangjian Jiang
pmc-12645059.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The beneficial effects of quinoa on metabolic diseases have been extensively investigated. In this context, we sought to study the efficacy of quinoa in a nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) mouse model and its underlying mechanism of action. Male ICR mice were fed a high‐fat diet for 12 weeks to establish a NAFLD model, followed by 6 weeks of quinoa intervention. The mechanism by which quinoa improves NAFLD was explored using network pharmacology analysis and transcriptome sequencing analysis.

pmc-13010151.title: Elucidating the kinetics of CRISPR–SaCas9 action to obtain effective HIV DNA excision with two gRNAs
pmc-13010151.creator: Zhenghao Yu, Yuanling Bao, Ana Alcalá-Lalinde, Zaria Andrade dos Ramos, Merve Koroglu, Ben Berkhout, Elena Herrera-Carrillo
pmc-13010151.description: The persistence of integrated human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) proviral DNA poses a major barrier to viral eradication, as the viral reservoir enables rapid rebound upon treatment interruption, despite effective virus inhibition. CRISPR–Cas-based editing strategies, especially those using double-site cleavage, show promise in excising proviral DNA, yet the rate and determinants of excision efficiency remain poorly understood.

pmc-13041229.title: Paediatric mental health liaison services in England: findings from a national survey
pmc-13041229.creator: Miriam Avery, Sue Kirk, Steven Pryjmachuk, William Lee, Kate Welsh
pmc-13041229.description: BackgroundPaediatric Mental Health Liaison (PMHL) in England is poorly understood with limited data on services previously collected.AimTo describe the characteristics of PMHL services in England and create a service model typology.MethodData were collected using a cross-sectional online survey adapted from the questionnaire used by the existing adult-care-focussed Liaison Psychiatry Surveys of England (LPSE).

pmc-13097200.title: Diagnostic Accuracy of CircRNAs for Detecting Gastrointestinal Cancers: An Updated Meta-analysis
pmc-13097200.creator: Jila Bahramirad, Yousef Moradi, Ghobad Moradi, Hojat Dehghanbanadaki, Mohammad Abdi, Sherko Nasseri
pmc-13097200.description: BackgroundGastrointestinal (GI) cancers remain a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, underscoring the urgent need for reliable, non-invasive diagnostic biomarkers. Circular RNAs (circRNAs), characterized by high stability and tissue specificity, have emerged as promising molecular indicators for early cancer detection.

pmc-13440561.title: Ceramide–Phospholipid Risk Score Associates With Cardiovascular Events and Is Lowered by Atorvastatin, Simvastatin, and Anti-PCSK9 Treatments
pmc-13440561.creator: Mika Hilvo, Angelika Witoslawska, Mitja Lääperi, Antti Jylhä, Leo-Pekka Lyytikäinen, Hannu Päivä, Jari Laurikka, Winfried März, Pekka J. Karhunen, Terho Lehtimäki, Reijo Laaksonen

INTRODUCTION Patients with an established coronary heart disease (CHD) with or without a history of myocardial infarction (MI) have a variable risk of cardiovascular (CV) complications such as death, myocardial infarction, or heart failure (HF).

pmc-13559304.creator: Masahiro Yanagiya
pmc-13559304.description: m outcomes of VATS have already been reported as prospective studies, and VATS has been widely adopted and recommended in clinical practice, clinical equipoise remains regarding the long-term oncological outcomes of VATS lobectomy (2-7). The meta-analysis mentioned above established solid evidence of superiority of VATS lobectomy over open thoracotomy for early-stage lung cancer regarding long-term outcomes (1).

pmc-13560317.title: RPE-derived extracellular matrix improves graft retention and photoreceptor preservation in preclinical models of retinal degeneration
pmc-13560317.creator: Fatemeh Sadat Hosseini Mazinani, Mohammad Kazemi Ashtiani, Azadeh Moradmand, Leila Satarian
pmc-13560317.description: IntroductionHuman pluripotent stem cells-derived retinal pigment epithelium (hPSC-RPE) represent a promising therapeutic approach for macular degeneration. This study examines whether RPE–derived extracellular matrix (RPE-ECM), enhances survival and functional outcomes following hPSC-RPE suspension transplantation in a preclinical model of retinal degeneration.MethodshPSC-RPE cells were cultured under three conditions: control, RPE-conditioned medium (RPE-CM), and RPE-ECM.

pmc-13655820.title: Acyclovir and ganciclovir exposure and short-term outcomes in hospitalized children with EBV-associated mononucleosis-like illness: a retrospective cohort study using inverse probability of treatment weighting
pmc-13655820.creator: Ying Ding, Qinghui Chen, Ruyue Chen, Xiaozhong Li
pmc-13655820.description: BackgroundEpstein-Barr virus (EBV)-associated mononucleosis-like illness in children involves marked immune activation and variable clinical severity. Although supportive care remains standard for immunocompetent children, acyclovir and ganciclovir are frequently used in hospitalized patients with severe manifestations. However, their real-world effectiveness remains uncertain.

pmc-13660150.title: Problem-solving capabilities in healthcare education: a multigroup analysis of psychological factors in medical and dental students
pmc-13660150.creator: Gökçe İşcan, Osman Gurdal
pmc-13660150.description: BackgroundProblem-solving is essential for healthcare professionals; nevertheless, the psychological mechanisms influencing it in educational settings remain insufficiently examined. Guided by an integrated framework combining Cognitive Load Theory, Self-Determination Theory, and Professional Identity Formation, this study examined how self-esteem and anxiety interact to influence problem-solving, anticipating systematic variations across programs and gender.
